g.text: ASSUMED COST SCENARIOS | Payback depends on k / delta
Explanatory sensitivity model across N feature cycles (units: AI credits; shared baseline cancels)
Not observed pilot data, forecast, monetary savings or a frozen protocol endpoint
Break-even depends on the ratio k / delta, not the units or a preferred k.
k awaits measured consolidation spend; delta is an uncapped, quality-matched counterfactual.
Illustrative boundary; integer cycles round up
